[NGST.3.1] An integrator compiles against `include/` and links
`lib/libds.a` and `lib/libprotobuf-c.a`, plus the platform libraries the
tarball names for its row. The tarball names them in the `[link]` section of
its `PROVENANCE.txt`, as the link line its row was tested with. They differ by
row, so no fixed list binds: a row may need `-lre2`, and a row may need no
thread library. The link must use a C++ driver: `libds.a` carries C++ objects
(the RE2 seam), and a C driver leaves their runtime unresolved.
